text: We were staying at a resort in Krabi and found a kitten with a skin disease. Our guide, Arun, who was leading the day's tour, kindly contacted the clinic. We were so well taken care of! ❤️ The veterinarian advised us on how and which medication we should use. Everything was clean and they have affordable prices – an excellent price! Upon leaving the hotel, I spoke with management and they will take the kitten back to the clinic to continue treatment.

The doctor was very kind and patient with my children. She checked my son thoroughly. The price was reasonable. Anyone in the Krabi area who wants to get their children vaccinated can come here. You won't be disappointed!

Reservations are required in advance. They even charge extra for the wound check-up appointment.
They do absolutely nothing, just take the cat that's already been spayed/neutered (and we've already paid for it) to the scheduled wound check-up, and they charge an extra 50 baht. This isn't normal.

The vet gave excellent advice and consultation, made a good diagnosis, the clinic was clean, the prices were very reasonable, and it was easy to get there. The staff were also very attentive and caring towards our pet.
This is a very good clinic. The doctor is very kind.

We brought a completely exhausted, old, stray dog. Despite payment, he couldn't be euthanized (due to Buddhist beliefs). He received some treatment and was returned to the street half-dead. Although the company, Wellfair (a dog rescue organization), is located on the next island, nothing was actually done for the poor animal.
Yes, I can recommend it. My cat received quick help. I've been going there for over a year and it's always been very good.

The doctor was very kind and spoke wonderfully. The staff were friendly.
The treatment cost was very affordable. I will definitely bring my cat here for sterilization again in the future.

This is the only animal clinic in the Sai Thai area. I took my sick cat there for treatment. The symptoms were similar to feline distemper. The vet gave my cat an injection and charged a reasonable price. The service was excellent and the vet was very polite. 😄 …
The doctor is lovely, and the assistant doctor is also lovely. They give good advice and take very good care of the cat. I took my cat here for treatment and felt comfortable and worry-free.

It was great, but there was a bit of a wait. The price was very cheap. You could go in and see the cats too. The vet explained all the cat's symptoms, advised on how to give medication, and how to observe the cat's condition.
Good service, polite staff, reasonable prices, close to home, no need to wait long, very great, they took care and looked after my cat very well.
The prices are incredibly reasonable, the staff are polite, and the service is excellent. I'm extremely impressed.
